blocks.text: Washwing joins a fan's folding gesture to the act of washing. By Era Four, those once separate tools have compounded into one small care object with a short name and a specific use.
A ribbed fan that releases a wash when snapped open.
One-shot use: The fan closes completely, snaps open, and sprays a broad burst from its ribs. The game performs the final fade.
20 silver. Infection / Parasites severity −2; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Cleanliness +12; Health +6. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
